snippet.title: 「Hachi: Eight Feet Tall」trailer | From the developer of Teke Teke: Moonlit Dread
snippet.description:
A game developed and created by Mohamed B. Chrifa
3D Assets: Elbolilloduro, jrevel, Mohanmed B. Chrifa
Trailer Editor, Chinese translator: 羊圈Yan-Gyan
Writer/English, Arabic and German translator: Mohanmed B. Chrifa
Music: 骸骨の踊り by EN_OKAWA
Voice Actors: Jade Ivy, @RandomKrabz

Download link: https://ookii-tsuki.itch.io/hachi-eight-feet-tall
